developer: Developer preview · Not notarized by Apple
freshBody: Add PDF conversion, Print to Fit, and PDF merging to this Mac account.
updateBody: A verified installation is available to update. All three actions will be replaced together.
legacyBody: Your existing installation was verified. Update it to work without keeping the downloaded source folder.
currentBody: This version is already installed. Conversion, app licensing, and permissions have not been verified.
installedBody: All three Quick Actions are installed. Conversion, app licensing, and permissions have not been verified.
recoveredBody: Inspect the current installation before trying another update.
conflictBody: An existing item could not be verified. Installation has stopped so that your files remain in place.
recoveryBody: A previous installation did not finish. Backups are being retained until recovery can be verified.
restoredBody: The replacement failed. The complete previous installation state has been restored.
busyBody: Finish the other installation before opening this installer again.
failedBody: The installer did not receive a verified result. No successful installation is being reported.
actions: Convert to PDF · Print to Fit · Merge PDFs
perUser: Installed for your Mac account. No administrator password is needed.
afterInstall: After installation, try a PNG through Finder Quick Actions.
preserve: Your documents, existing PDFs, and printer preferences are preserved.
finderStep: 1. In Finder, select a PNG and open Quick Actions → Convert to PDF.
pngStep: 2. Open the resulting PDF and check its page and image.
permissionStep: 3. If an action is missing, enable it in Quick Actions settings. Grant app access only when macOS asks during your own conversion.
reopenStep: Close this window, then reopen the installer to inspect again.
recoverStep: Choose Recover to finish recovery before installing again.
contactStep: Keep the existing files and any backups. Share the diagnostic code with the project maintainer.
inspectBody: Reading installation ownership and file integrity. No document apps are opened.
workingBody: Keep this window open. The installer will complete the change or restore the previous state.
recoveringBody: Keep this window open while the installation state is checked and recovery is completed.
notChecked: Startup, licensing, permissions, and conversion readiness were not checked.
protocol: The backend response was missing, invalid, or contradicted its exit status.
inspectUnavailableBody: Reading the installation took too long. Existing installed items were not changed. Close this window and try again later.
registrationBody: The installed files were verified, but Finder menu registration needs checking.
registrationEnableStep: 2. If the actions are missing, enable them in Quick Actions settings.
registrationPNGStep: 3. Try a PNG through Quick Actions → Convert to PDF.
inspectCleanupBody: The check could not be safely stopped yet and is still being tracked. Try Close again, or let the check finish. Installed items were not changed.
menuToggle: Show icon in the menu bar
preferenceErrorTitle: Menu setting could not be changed
preferenceErrorBody: The menu setting could not be read, saved, or displayed. Check the setting again before relying on it.
loginMove: Move this app to Applications before enabling login launch.
loginApproval: Requires approval in macOS Login Items.
loginUnavailable: Login launch is unavailable or its status could not be read.
loginErrorTitle: Login setting could not be changed
loginErrorBody: macOS did not confirm the requested change. Check the status shown here or in Login Items.
loginNotRegistered: Login launch has not been set up yet.
